technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring XD architecture and Spring Batch framework paradigms for tasklet and module implementations.
Implement Kafka encoder/decoder customization by exposing configurable serializer/deserializer properties in the Spring XD Kafka transport and module definitions.
Develop the gpfdist sink module as a specialized file-server-backed sink module capable of streaming data directly to Greenplum Database (GPDB) parallel loading instances.
Implement the gpload tasklet as a Spring Batch Tasklet wrapper that executes gpload system commands with configurable YAML control files and runtime parameters.
Isolate Hadoop JAR dependencies into dedicated, optional module ClassLoaders rather than loading them globally in the root application classpath.
Implement dynamic module ClassLoading using customizable path pattern resolvers that can evaluate tokens like '${distro}', '${provider}', and explicit directory paths at module launch time.
Integrate Spring Flo into Admin UI by embedding the visual component framework via standard web asset packaging and REST API wiring.
assumptions: A single senior Java software engineer with expertise in Spring Framework, Spring XD, Spring Batch, and messaging technologies will perform all implementation tasks.
Greenplum Database (GPDB) and Kafka test environments are readily available for integration testing.
Target environment supports Java 17+ and modern Spring XD dependency structures.
No external third-party proprietary blockers exist for gpfdist and gpload utility invocations.

activities.activity_description: Expose configurable encoder/decoder strategies for Kafka source, sink, and bus components, allowing users to define custom data formats and serialization strategies.
Develop and package an out-of-the-box gpfdist sink module for high-speed parallel data ingestion into GPDB/HAWQ.

activities.activity_name: UI Infrastructure Setup for Admin UI and Flo Integration (U3)
activities.activity_description: Set up frontend and backend UI build infrastructure to seamlessly integrate the Admin UI and Spring Flo visual stream/job designer.

activities.activity_name: End-to-End Kafka Demonstration and Benchmark Suite (U4)
activities.activity_description: Design and build an end-to-end Kafka + Spring XD benchmark use-case to demonstrate, study, and verify high-throughput scale and performance.

activities.activity_name: Optimized File Ingestion Strategy and Tasklet Evaluation (U5)
activities.activity_description: Evaluate and implement an efficient file reading pattern using tasklets to avoid line-by-line in-memory processing and message bus transmission overhead.
Implement a Spring Batch gpload tasklet to execute efficient bulk file loading into GPDB, complete with error handling and configuration parsing.

activities.activity_name: Decouple Hadoop Dependencies from Root Classpath (U7)
activities.activity_description: Refactor application startup classpath loading to isolate and make Hadoop dependencies optional when HDFS is not used as a module registry.
Implement custom dynamic ClassLoader mechanics capable of parsing path tokens and resolving module dependencies from options or custom locations at runtime.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all updated components, dynamic classloading scenarios, and data movement workflows.
